promptLatex: In a circle with centre $O$, the central angle $\angle AOB$ measures $74^{\circ}$. What is the measure of the major arc $AB$, in degrees?
hintLatex: An arc measures the same number of degrees as the central angle that cuts it off.
The two arcs between the same pair of points together make one full turn.
The minor arc is $74^{\circ}$, so the major arc is $360 - 74 = 286$.
solutionLatex:
The minor arc $AB$ is the one the central angle $\angle AOB = 74^{\circ}$ cuts off, and an arc and its standing central angle have the same measure.

That gives the minor arc as $74^{\circ}$. The other arc from $A$ back to $B$ is the major arc, and the two together make a full turn.

So the major arc measures $360^{\circ} - 74^{\circ} = 286^{\circ}$.
